# Release - API Management service: October, 2026

## What Changed

Announcements / highlights Improved gateway reliability. Fixed stale backend connection reuse, TLS certificate initialization issues during gateway restarts, and false capacity related HTTP 429 responses. Internal health probes are no longer disrupted by capacity throttling or connection rebalancing. More flexible WebSocket routing and load balancing. Added wildcard and URL template matching for routing multiple paths through a single WebSocket API, plus support for distributing connections across backend pools. Enhanced backend certificate validation. Added SHA 256 and SHA 512 certificate thumbprints, issuer only pinning without a common name requirement, and matching against intermediate certificates in the available chain. Expanded messaging controls. Added configurable Event Hubs logging message size limits and Service Bus correlation ID, reply to, and scheduled enqueue time properties. More reliable caching and API updates. Fixed truncated cached responses and addressed API import/update failures involving operation ID changes and HTTP method/path conflicts. Stronger credential protection and request validation. Improved secret redaction in API exports and import errors, ti...
